title: Cascading blackout — Getafe, Community of Madrid

elements.name: Juan de la Cierva Fuel Station 5

timeline.note: Moment 1 — blackout at the Getafe-Sur substation: every site it supplies goes down.

payload.text: Power is out across all of Getafe Norte
Anyone else without power in Getafe? #blackout
Five minutes without power, this is a disgrace
@iberdrola what is going on in Getafe??
Resident asks when power returns to their street
my fridge has been off a while, everything is going to spoil
No power in Getafe again, just like April 2025
Local outlet requests a statement on the scope of the outage
The whole of El Bercial district is dark, not just the centre
No wifi, no TV, does anyone know anything
Patrol 14 reports: traffic lights out on Av. Juan Carlos I, slow-moving traffic
#blackout Getafe is trending already
Person trapped in a lift on calle Madrid 12 — fire service already alerted through another channel
Getafe-Norte substation: breaker bank tripped, no restoration ETA
Odd humming in the industrial estate, probably the datacenter generator
My router has had no signal for 20 minutes
Caller says the El Bercial hospital is switching everything over to generators
Datacenter sensor T-14 reports 87 °C — inconsistent with the adjacent sensors
Interview request for the 3pm news bulletin
Is that smoke coming from the edge datacenter by Los Ángeles? Hard to tell

timeline.note: Moment 2 — the datacenter starts overheating on a limited UPS.

payload.text: Power is out in Getafe!! (posted 40 minutes ago)
Traffic lights out at the España roundabout, jams forming on every approach
Datacenter technician confirms a hot aisle in row B
Local radio asks whether the western districts are affected too
Temperature probe H-2 at the east medical centre reads -3 °C — impossible
Las Margaritas substation operators confirm a total outage on the west ring
Intermittent mobile coverage in the north; some calls are not getting through
No mobile coverage in Las Margaritas since the blackout began
My phone is dead, no calls and no data

timeline.note: Moment 3 — the tower batteries are draining: if it falls, the ability to coordinate is lost.

payload.text: Caller reports her father is on a home ventilator with one hour of battery left
anyone know if the supermarket is open?
Three hours without power already

timeline.note: Moment 4 — the hospital loses its backup generator: a direct conflict over resources.

payload.text: Hospital confirms the main generator set will not start
People are leaving the hospital, what is going on?
Can you confirm an incident at the Regional Hospital?
Dialysis patient asks whether the El Bercial hospital still has power
Resident reports the branch cash machine is down
A-42 service station: pumps have no power, unable to dispense
M-409 service station: pumps dead, ambulances queuing for diesel
The lights at the east medical centre keep flickering, is anyone on it?

timeline.note: Moment 5 — the crew misses its ETA: the plan relied on it and must be rebuilt.

payload.text: Massive jam on Juan Carlos I
Traffic at a standstill on the hospital approach
been stuck in the car for 25 minutes
Voltage sensor SUB-3 reports 400% — outside any physical range
Is there an estimate for restoration?
Council press office asks how many substations are actually down
Crowd building at the España roundabout crossing, vehicles cannot move
THE POWER IS BACK 🎉
Still no power on our street, going on nine hours
We would like a summary of the incident
